result.title: PartPO: Part-Level Policy Optimization for Shape-to-Program Generation
result.summary: We present PartPO, a reinforcement learning method for generating structured shape programs from 3D point clouds. Existing shape-to-program models are trained with supervised learning on procedurally generated data and generalize poorly to more diverse shapes, while reinforcement learning from execution feedback assigns a single scalar reward to a long program that builds many parts, making credit assignment difficult. PartPO instead builds on a core property of the task: shape programs are self-describing, with each semantically named part produced by its own code block. It segments each generated program by its parts and applies part-level rewards only to the code of the corresponding part, a category reward only to the object name, and a shape-level reward to the whole program. The required part supervision is obtained without manual annotation, by grounding part names on target meshes with an open-vocabulary segmentation model prompt-tuned on the model's own outputs. Applied to MeshCoder, PartPO improves reconstruction accuracy and execution success on ShapeNetCore and ABO over the base model, rejection-sampling fine-tuning and trajectory-level RL, and generalizes to the unseen HSSD dataset. Code will be released at https://github.com/HannuoZ/PartPO.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PartPO，用于从 3D 点云生成结构化形状程序：利用形状程序「自描述」的性质，将生成程序按语义部件切块，把部件级与类别级奖励只施加到对应代码段，并用开放词表分割得到的部件接地作为免标注监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按结构分段做细粒度 credit assignment 的思路，可能可供核查 LVR 中长推理轨迹的贡献分配与局部监督设计，但任务与模态均为 3D 形状程序，与视觉 latent 推理只是方法层面相似。
